description: List work items in a project

fields.description: List of additional fields to include in the response beyond the defaults (System.Id, System.Title, System.State, System.AssignedTo). Use full field reference names, e.g. "Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.StoryPoints", "System.IterationPath", "System.AreaPath".

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

queryId.description: ID of a saved work item query

skip.description: Number of work items to skip

top.description: Maximum number of work items to return

name: list_work_items
